items.Sentence: The headworks consists of an influent pump station, comminutors, bar screen, aerated grit chambers, and primary sedimentation.
There are six primary sedimentation tanks that are operated in parallel.
Effluent is pumped into nine aeration tanks ... operating in parallel with biological nitrification and denitrification.
The secondary clarifiers consist of 14 tanks operating in parallel.
Waste activated sludge is sent to the dissolved air flotation system prior to being sent to the anaerobic digestion system.
Anaerobic sludge digestion occurs in the digesters.
Effluent is disinfected with chloramine ... prior to entering six dual media gravity filters for reduction of turbidity and suspended solids.
The Facility provides tertiary, disinfected treatment by utilizing the following treatment process sequence: ... chloramine disinfection.
Prior to delivery to Piute Ponds, disinfected recycled water is dechlorinated to protect aquatic life.
The maintenance performed on the existing drying pads for biosolids has allowed digested biosolids to be air dried.
Dewatered biosolids ... are eventually hauled off-site for composting to an authorized facility.
All of the unlined oxidation ponds and unlined storage reservoirs have not been in use since 2012 when use of the new lined Storage V Reservoirs was initiated.
